ideas.pitch: An AI-powered matchmaking platform for senior citizens in Mumbai to form local companionship groups and coordinate volunteer drivers for social outings.
ideas.problem_statement: Community isolation among urban elderly populations in Mumbai.
ideas.title: SeniorLink Mumbai
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets community and social issues with high social impact, matching the explicit judging criteria of innovation and practical social welfare.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web app utilizing device cameras to scan product barcodes and packaging, providing hyper-local recycling instructions and drop-off center locations across Mumbai.
ideas.problem_statement: Local urban waste management and improper household garbage disposal.
ideas.title: EcoScan Mumbai
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven success pattern of environmental and sustainability applications with immediate practical utility for municipal waste reduction.

ideas.pitch: A localized legal networking portal connecting underprivileged communities in Mumbai with volunteer law students and practitioners offering pro-bono advice.
ideas.problem_statement: Lack of accessible legal aid for marginalized communities in urban centers.
ideas.title: ProBono Connect
ideas.why_it_could_win: High practicality and social impact score, addressing a severe community pain point with a clear, scalable digital workflow.

ideas.pitch: An agentic workflow platform to track, report, and coordinate rehabilitation resources for rescued child labor and vulnerable daily-wage workers.
ideas.problem_statement: Child labor and exploitation tracking in regional unorganized sectors.
ideas.title: ShramikSahay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a deeply embedded social issue with structured data management, appealing strongly to judges looking for high societal transformation potential.

ideas.pitch: A digital administrative portal designed for Mumbai B.Tech colleges to eliminate paper trails in grievance redressal, document approvals, and student event clearances.
ideas.problem_statement: Inefficient institutional paperwork and bureaucratic waste in educational establishments.
ideas.title: CampusPaperless
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly resonates with the college audience and judging panel by solving an administrative bottleneck present in their own institutions.
